description: Solid mid-level frontend developer vs a senior full-stack JD. Real overlap on React/TypeScript, clear gaps on backend and infrastructure. Should read as competitive-with-gaps, not hireable-today.
resumeText:
SARA AL-QAHTANI
Frontend Developer | Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
sara.qahtani@email.com | github.com/saraq

SUMMARY
Frontend developer with 3 years of experience building responsive web applications in React and TypeScript for fintech and e-commerce products.

EXPERIENCE

Frontend Developer — Tamara (fintech), Jeddah | Aug 2023 – Present
- Built customer onboarding flows in React 18 + TypeScript serving 300K monthly users; onboarding completion rose 22% after a redesign I led.
- Introduced React Query for server-state caching, cutting duplicate API calls by 40%.
- Wrote unit and integration tests with Jest and React Testing Library, raising coverage on the checkout package from 30% to 85%.
- Collaborated with backend engineers consuming REST APIs; wrote API-contract tests against OpenAPI specs.

Junior Frontend Developer — Noon.com, remote | Jul 2022 – Jul 2023
- Implemented product-listing and search UI components in React and Redux used across 3 country storefronts.
- Reduced bundle size 35% via code splitting and lazy loading; Lighthouse performance score improved from 61 to 89.
- Fixed 100+ UI bugs across RTL (Arabic) and LTR layouts.

EDUCATION
B.Sc. Computer Science — King Abdulaziz University, 2022

SKILLS
React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES2023), Redux, React Query, Jest, React Testing Library, HTML/CSS, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Git, REST APIs, i18n/RTL
jobDescription:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer

We need a senior engineer who owns features end to end across our web platform.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Expert React and TypeScript on the frontend
- Strong backend experience with Node.js (Express or NestJS)
- Production experience designing and consuming GraphQL APIs
- PostgreSQL schema design and query optimization
- Deploying and operating services on Kubernetes (EKS) and AWS
- CI/CD ownership (GitHub Actions) and on-call participation

You will design APIs, own database migrations, and mentor two mid-level engineers.
